fullContentHtml:
SSC GD Constable Result 2026 – Out – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the result for the SSC Constable GD in BSF, CISF, ITBP, CRPF, NCB, SSF, Assam Rifles on the official website. This recruitment was conducted for 25,487 posts. Applications for the SSC GD Constable Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 01 December 2025 to 31 December 2025. The examination was held from 27 April 2026 to 30 May 2026. Candidates who had appeared for this exam can download their SSC GD Constable Result 2026, rom the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 01 December 2025
  • Application Start Date : 01 December 2025
  • Last Date : 31 December 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 January 2026
  • Last Date Correction : 10-13 January 2026
  • Prelim Exam Date : 23 February 2026 (Postponed)
  • New Exam Date : 27 April to 30 May 2026
  • Choose Exam Week Preference : 11-15 April 2026
  • Exam City Details : 19 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 24 April 2026
  • Answer Key Available : 15 June 2026
  • Result Available : 12 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Female Candidates : 0/-
  • Correction Charge
  • First Time : Rs. 200/-
  • Second Time : Rs. 500/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
